outgoing.name: Ancient Greece
outgoing.excerpt: It is known that the Greeks used the concepts of angle and radius.

outgoing.name: Archimedes
outgoing.excerpt: In On Spirals, Archimedes describes his famous spiral, a function whose radius depends on the angle.

outgoing.name: Blaise Pascal
outgoing.excerpt: Blaise Pascal subsequently used polar coordinates to calculate the length of parabolic arcs.

outgoing.name: Engineering
outgoing.excerpt: The polar coordinate system is used in many fields, including mathematics, physics, engineering, navigation and robotics.

outgoing.name: Leonhard Euler
outgoing.excerpt: Alexis Clairaut and Leonhard Euler are credited with extending the concept of polar coordinates to three dimensions.

outgoing.name: Physics
